text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Casablanca city council to sign takeover of water and electricity distribution by French firm, Lyonnaise des Eaux.
- Rabat to host executive meeting of Arab justice ministers starting Tuesday.
- Moroccan lawyers' association calls for liberation of enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla held by Spain.
- Maghreb Arab Union stalled by Algerian hostility over Morocco's sovereignty in Western Sahara.
- International forum on Morocco's social issues told that country's greatest problem is illiteracy, with only 45 percent of people able to read and write.
- James Baker, U.N. special envoy in Western Sahara, ends tour of region by visiting Tindouf camps in Algeria.
